B29K.fTerm:
INDEXING SCHEME ASSOCIATED WITH SUBCLASSES B29B, B29C OR B29D, RELATING TO MOULDING MATERIALS OR TO MATERIALS FOR REINFORCEMENTS, FILLERS OR PREFORMED PARTS, e.g. INSERTS[4]

Note(s)

  • This subclass constitutes an indexing scheme associated with subclasses B29B, B29C or B29D.[4]
  • In this subclass, the following term is used with the meaning indicated:
    • "rubber" covers:
      • natural or conjugated diene rubbers;
      • rubber in general (for a specific rubber, other than a natural rubber or a conjugated diene rubber, see the group provided for such macromolecular compounds).
